title: SQL construct labels
instruction: Separately, label which SQL constructs each answer used.

labels.name: none
labels.description: neither; the query is written with joins only

labels.name: subquery
labels.description: uses a nested SELECT: `IN (SELECT ...)`, `EXISTS (SELECT ...)`, `= (SELECT ...)`, a scalar subquery, or `FROM (SELECT ...)`

notes: `JOIN` of any kind, `SELECT DISTINCT`, `CASE WHEN`, a top-level `UNION`/`UNION ALL` between same-level SELECTs, `GROUP BY`/`HAVING` without a nested SELECT, `ORDER BY`, `LIMIT`, and constant lists like `IN ('a','b')` are all `none`.
Quote the line verbatim when you label an answer `cte` or `subquery`.
